description: Find all incoming callers of a function or method. Shortcut for find_callers with direction='incoming'. Use before deleting or refactoring a function to see who depends on it.

cross_concurrent.description: If true\, annotate callers that cross concurrent boundaries (goroutines\, threads\, async tasks). Returns concurrent_callers with the detected pattern.

direction.description: Direction: incoming\, outgoing\, or both (default: both)

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript\, python). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

name: callers
